subject: Geolocation assertion and private-link runbook for Solstice
messages:
From: Solstice Security <security-contact@solstice.co>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: geolocation & VPC evidence for contract (SOC2/SIG)

Hi Vivek,

As part of our procurement and security review for the upcoming contract, our security team needs a short, signed statement confirming Redwood's hosting and private networking controls for Solstice workloads. Specifically we are asking for:

- Formal geolocation assertion: which regions will host Solstice production data (EU/US/APAC); whether we can require EU-only hosting.
- A short VPC/private-link runbook (customer-visible steps for establishing PrivateLink peering or dedicated VPC connectivity).
- KMS/crypto controls: are keys region-partitioned? do you support customer-managed keys? any HSM-backed options?
- Audit log retention and how to export logs for our SIEM.
- Confirmation that hosting infrastructure is in-scope for Redwood's SOC 2 report and that SIG/CAIQ responses are available.

We'd like a response and accompanying artifacts (runbook, network diagram, KMS matrix) by Friday 2026-10-22 to keep our timeline. Can you confirm who will be the primary contact for technical evidence?

Thanks,
Anil Rao
Head of Security Operations
Solstice Technologies
security-contact@solstice.co

--
Note: we may provide a short questionnaire; please flag any items that need legal approval.

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Solstice Security <security-contact@solstice.co>, Anil Rao <anil@solstice.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: geolocation & VPC evidence for contract (SOC2/SIG)

Hi Anil — thanks for the clear list.

I'll be the point here for contractual confirmation. I've looped in Marissa (Customer Success / onboarding) and Neha (Security & Compliance) to put together the artifacts. We can provide:

- A signed geolocation statement for Solstice (we can assert EU-only production hosting when requested and when tenant is pinned to eu-west-1).
- A short VPC/PrivateLink runbook describing options (AWS PrivateLink, VPC Peering, Transit Gateway attachment) and the steps your infra team needs to take.
- A KMS partitioning matrix and details on customer-managed key support (we support CMKs and HSM-backed KMS via partner integrations).
- Audit log export instructions and retention options.
- Copies of SIG/CAIQ and a pointer to our SOC 2 scope.

Marissa/Neha — can you take first pass on the runbook + network diagram? We should aim to send a consolidated package tomorrow (2026-10-19) morning. Anil — confirm whether "production only" is the required scope or if staging/preview environments also need EU-only hosting.

Best,

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: geolocation & VPC evidence for contract (SOC2/SIG)

Vivek — copying in my draft artifacts for internal review before we send to Solstice.

Attachments (drafts):
- vpc_runbook_solstice_v1.docx (draft runbook — step-by-step for PrivateLink + Transit GW)
- network_diagram_aws_privatelink.png (diagram showing PrivateLink endpoints + peering path)
- kms_partitioning_matrix.xlsx (region/key mapping and CMK options)
- redwood_geolocation_statement.pdf (templated geolocation declaration)

Notes:
- For Solstice we can offer a tenant-level pin to eu-west-1 for production. This requires a flag in onboarding that pins the tenant and disables cross-region failover; documented in the runbook.
- PrivateLink option uses a customer-owned NLB + interface endpoint in your VPC; we provide the vended endpoint service name. Transit Gateway attachment is an alternative for customers who want full VPC peering across accounts.
- KMS: by default we use Redwood-managed keys per-region; we can accept a customer-managed CMK (BYOK) which will be region-bound and never exported. We have an HSM-backed option available via our enterprise KMS addon (requires a separate agreement).
- Audit logs: we retain control plane / audit events for 90 days by default but can set export to your S3/CloudWatch/OCI bucket for 365-day retention on request.

Please review and suggest changes — Neha, anything to add on SOC2/SIG references?

Subject: Re: Geolocation assertion and private-link runbook for Solstice

Anil — thanks for the patience. Attached is the package we discussed: the signed geolocation statement, a VPC/PrivateLink runbook tailored for Solstice onboarding, a network diagram, and the KMS partitioning matrix. Summary of the assertions and artifacts included below so you can track against your procurement checklist: 

1) Geolocation assertion (attached: redwood_geolocation_statement.pdf)
- For Solstice account SOL-872 we confirm that production workloads can be pinned to a single region: eu-west-1 (Ireland). When pinned, storage and runtime for that tenant are provisioned in eu-west-1 and we will not failover to other regions unless explicitly authorized by Solstice.

2) Private connectivity runbook (attached: vpc_runbook_solstice_v1.docx)
- Options included: AWS PrivateLink (recommended for minimal routing changes), Transit Gateway attachment, or dedicated VPC peering. The runbook lists the required customer steps (create interface endpoints/NLB, provide CIDR ranges, share VPC IDs) and the Redwood-side steps (publish endpoint service name, allocate private IPs, configure routing). Estimated time-to-connect: 2-4 business days after infra provisioning.

3) KMS and key handling (attached: kms_partitioning_matrix.xlsx)
- By default Redwood uses region-scoped keys. We support customer-managed CMKs (BYOK) that are region-bound and not exportable. HSM-backed KMS is available as an enterprise addon. Keys used for eu-west-1 instances remain in eu-west-1.

4) Audit logs and export
- Control plane and audit events are retained for 90 days by default. We offer automated export to a customer S3 bucket and can extend retention to 365 days on request (configuration documented in the runbook).

5) Compliance scope
- Redwood's production hosting and the eu-west-1 tenant provisioning flow are included in our SOC 2 scope. SIG/CAIQ answers and a redacted SOC 2 summary are available; Neha can follow up with formal versions if you need them for your security questionnaire.

Next steps: please confirm the scope (production-only vs. staging also) and confirm the primary infra contact for the connection (NOC/Cloud infra engineer). Once we have those, we can schedule a 30-minute handoff call to walk through the runbook and timeline.

If you'd like, we can also provide a short attestation letter on company letterhead; tell me who to address it to.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142
